intro.title: I'm Sasha
intro.p1: I started out in the music industry, working as a live sound engineer at Fabric London and DJing while completing my BA in Music Production & Sound Engineering at Point Blank.
intro.p2: But I wanted to go deeper. Immediately after graduating, I enrolled in a Mathematics and Computer Science degree at Aix-Marseille University. For the first year, I studied online while still living in London and working night shifts at the club.
intro.p3: Eventually, I decided to go all in. I moved to Marseille to fully focus on mastering the complex fundamentals of the field. I'm now in my third year, driven by a desire to work in an industry with scalable impact and to understand the deep logic and architecture that powers our software.

air_harp.title: Air-Harp: Computer Vision Musical Instrument
air_harp.desc: Air-Harp is an interactive computer vision application that transforms your hand movements into a digital musical instrument. By using your webcam and Google’s MediaPipe technology, it detects your finger positions in real-time to "pluck" virtual strings suspended in mid-air.
